codeReview.summary: Reviewed the fix commit against the four round-1 actor-system failures. The patch resolves all eight blockers it set out to address: emailDispatch now has the critical-actor restart supervisor, stale registry identifiers are gone, auth grains no longer depend on Ask replies for retried email dispatch, Windows bind-conflict matching covers the mission host's error forms, and the updated tests now assert heartbeat payload fields, discovery-key coverage, runner-list response fields, and rejection of invalid operation transitions.
